purpose: Correctness-verified JVM function coverage costs under the accepted UDF performance exception; no acceleration claim.
method: Complete-job executeSql/await timer after symmetric EXPLAIN, with row source, blackhole sink, callback and owned output conversion, and both perimeter transposes. Fresh environment per trial, alternating engine order. Cluster setup/teardown is outside the job timer. Previous production uses unchanged Java sources and the identical fixture sources and release DSO. Its enabled control requires zero native substitutions/work; candidate requires both transposes, no fallback and positive native table-function input on every trial.
limitations: Background macOS indexing/analysis processes consumed substantial sampled CPU; no other Java processes were observed.
Large-input stock controls drift between independent forks and include outliers. Preserve every trial and do not interpret cross-fork differences as an isolated optimization effect.
Host observations contain UTC gaps; process duration is not used as operator/job throughput.
Short runs retain startup/JIT costs. No slower result is excluded and no throughput admission is claimed.
